description: The main window: core, plus dragging the window by its header and bringing it forward; showing system notifications and hearing their clicks; opening sign-in pages (https only) in your browser; the system's folder picker (Pick a folder: Plan 21). Opening your mcp.json in your editor, and ion's memory folder and its Markdown files, is granted at start, for those paths only (lib.rs). No shell, no file system; the UI reaches the daemon over WebSocket.
